name: NeetoForm
description:
NeetoForm is form-building software. You build a form, share its link, and the answers people send back arrive as submissions you can read and report on. This connector lets Claude work with your NeetoForm workspace in plain language.

Ask Claude to find a form by name when you only half-remember the title, check whether it is published, enabled and still collecting answers, or pull the submissions for it and summarise what people actually said. Each answer comes back paired with the question that produced it and the kind of field it came from, so a star rating, a multi-select and a long written comment all read correctly rather than as bare values. It can also list who has access to the workspace and invite, update or deactivate team members.

Because the responses arrive as readable text rather than a spreadsheet, a question like "what are the three most common complaints in this month's feedback" gets answered without exporting a CSV first.

Connect over OAuth and the connector acts as you: it reaches only the forms and submissions that account can already open in NeetoForm, and creating, updating or deleting team members are opt-in permissions you approve separately. Submission answers are stripped of internal bookkeeping before they are returned - record ids, positions, timestamps and the signed URLs behind uploaded files - and photo and signature answers come back as a filename rather than a downloadable link.

_published_faq.name: How do I add NeetoForm to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add NeetoForm to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://connect.neetoform.com/mcp/messages. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the NeetoForm MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: NeetoForm provides these MCP tools: CreateTeamMember, DeleteTeamMember, GetTeamMember, ListForms, ListSubmissions, ListTeamMembers, ListWorkspaces, UpdateTeamMember, fetch, and search.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to NeetoForm?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to NeetoForm in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
NeetoForm requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
NeetoForm is developed by Neeto. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
